note: Machine-readable feature ledger for the Chiron lane. PRODUCT.md is authoritative for WHY/scope; this file is authoritative for WHAT the loop may build next. Vertical slices, each with deps + non-goals, all scoped by PRODUCT.md. Query with features.cjs (do not hand-parse). status: done|open|blocked|escalate. A slice is BUILDABLE when status=open AND every dep is done AND it is not escalate. The planner takes the next buildable slice in array order. This fixes (a) the duplicate-work bug (two tasks both 'add a landing page' -> the arm now sees C2 is done), and (b) the base-branch failure (a slice bases on its already-merged deps, e.g. the pages depend on the nav). Keep in sync with state/roadmaps/chiron.md: this file wins on ordering/deps, the roadmap is the human-readable mirror.

features.slice: Next.js shell that builds cleanly (app/ layout + Home stub)
Home: hero title, one-line pitch, primary CTA linking to /learn
Shared header/nav component (links Home, /learn, /about) rendered on every page
non_goals: no active-route highlight required for v1

features.slice: /learn index: a responsive grid of lesson cards (title + one-line summary), each linking to its lesson page
/about: a short static description of what Chiron is and who it is for
Per-lesson pages with REAL 5-series content (>= 3 lessons), reached from the /learn cards
features.escalate: The lesson CURRICULUM/content is a product decision (PRODUCT.md #6). The loop may build the per-lesson page STRUCTURE against placeholder content, but must ESCALATE for the real curriculum rather than invent it.
